title: Kehai replay camera path
description: <stem>.path.json, next to a shift's .krec: keyframes saved with K in the 3D replay (ShotPath.cs), played back as one smooth camera move. Render it with render_shot.sh -shot <file> (or -shot path for the recording's own). Times are seconds into the shift; positions are world metres.

krec.description: The recording the path was made in (file name).

keys.description: In time order. A key within 0.05 s of another replaces it.

rotation.description: A unit quaternion (Unity: x, y, z, w).

focus.description: Focus distance in metres, for depth of field.
